hook: The easternmost point of the United States is in Alaska.

beats.narration: The easternmost point of the United States is in Alaska.
beats.claim: The easternmost point of the US by longitude is Pochnoi Point on Semisopochnoi Island, Alaska.

beats.narration: Alaska's Aleutian Islands stretch so far west, they cross the 180th meridian into the Eastern Hemisphere.
beats.claim: The Aleutian Islands cross the 180th meridian, which separates the eastern and western hemispheres.

beats.narration: Semisopochnoi Island sits at 179 degrees east. By longitude, that's the most eastern point in the country.
beats.claim: Semisopochnoi Island (51°57′42″N 179°46′23″E) is the easternmost point in all US territory by longitude.

beats.narration: And Amatignak Island, at 179 degrees west, is the most western.
beats.claim: Amatignak Island (51°16′7″N 179°8′55″W) is the westernmost point in the US by longitude.

beats.narration: The two extremes are only about 71 miles apart.
beats.claim: The distance between the easternmost and westernmost US points is about 71 miles.

beats.narration: So Alaska is the northernmost, westernmost and easternmost state. Hawaii keeps the south.
beats.claim: Alaska is simultaneously the northernmost, westernmost and easternmost state; the southernmost title belongs to Hawaii.

title: The easternmost point of the USA is in Alaska
description: Alaska is the northernmost, westernmost and easternmost US state. Here's how.
